name: WBI Energy Dakota Pipeline
researcher_notes: Distinct from every roster row: P2625 Tioga to Emerson (MDU 2020 to Manitoba) and the 2022 halt are not this line. The 2022 AP/CBS report (WBI letter to the ND Pipeline Authority, trans-state project, $150M state grant window, cost not disclosed) describes a later western-to-eastern ND project, the precursor of Bakken East (EIA Aug 2026 sheet row 12, Watford City to Fargo, Pre-applied, FERC PF26-4); it names no Moorhead/Viking tie-in or 375-400 mi length, so it is NOT linked to this 2013 line and is not a status source for it. Dakota Pipeline: OGJ May 2013 says WBI proposed ~400 MMcf/d, mostly 24-in line from ~20 mi SW of Williston ND to a Viking Gas Transmission interconnection NE of Moorhead MN, two compressor stations, $600-700M, construction early 2016. OGJ Jan 2014 (search-result description; article body is paywalled) says WBI launched an open season for its planned 375-mile Dakota pipeline; open season is the concrete step. EIA Aug 2026 workbook, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 1150: Dakota Pipeline, WBI Energy Transmission, New Pipeline, On Hold, ND/MN, cost 650 (millions) = $650M, 24 in, 400 MMcf/d, interstate. EIA's length cell reads 24 (the diameter), a data error; the 375 mi comes from OGJ. Passes length rule (375 mi, over 15.5 mi). Status shelved from EIA On Hold (single origin; ShelvedYear unknown, left blank). Capacity/cost agree between OGJ and EIA but EIA likely copied the sponsor figures, so independence is modest. Owner spelled as EIA does; gazetteer only offers a fuzzy hit 'WBI Energy', not adopted. Parent MDU Resources Group Inc is an exact gazetteer match. Fuzzy start: Williston is the nearest town, the source says about 20 miles southwest of it. No route found; RouteType unavailable. Not checked: FERC docket (none seen, project never filed), state sources.
